acceptance_mechanics.common: Every mutation requires a durably matching AuthorizationUseRecord resolved from the configured store; a constructed but absent record has no authority. Consumption precedes mutation and is permanent even if the later mutation fails.
acceptance_mechanics.registry_acceptance: Candidate is DRAFT or REVIEWED, exact content/hash already passes its owner validator, operation/target/lifecycle match, no conflict exists; append a new immutable ACCEPTED registry state without changing candidate content.
acceptance_mechanics.registry_supersession: Predecessor is ACCEPTED, successor is DRAFT or REVIEWED, accepted I-2 SupersessionRelation validator passes, relation refs match, version increases and content changes; one atomic registry transaction appends predecessor SUPERSEDED and successor ACCEPTED states.
acceptance_mechanics.configuration_acceptance: validate_experiment_configuration passes on the exact candidate and supplied fault-schedule witness; authorization targets exact draft ref; append ACCEPTED without changing configuration content.
acceptance_mechanics.binding_acceptance: validate_execution_binding passes; referenced configuration is already ACCEPTED and exact; accepted_configuration_ref matches; append ACCEPTED without changing binding content.
acceptance_mechanics.operational_ledger: validate_ledger passes before append; LedgerKind is OPERATIONAL; predecessor, ordinal, and head are exact; append entry and new head atomically. Scientific-ledger append remains I-5.
acceptance_mechanics.synthetic: Validation profiles may perform the same transitions only in a temporary store and reserved ebu:*:validation:* namespaces. Cleanup removes only the validated temporary directory after all handles close.
acceptance_mechanics.production: Until an exact governance bootstrap instance passes its schema and is operator-pinned, all five I-4 mutation callables fail PRODUCTION_BOOTSTRAP_MISSING before service, SQLite, registry, or ledger mutation.

sqlite_contract.duplicate: On primary-key conflict issue ROLLBACK; one read-only exact-key lookup may classify ALREADY_CONSUMED only when the stored coupled rows validate exactly; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
sqlite_contract.lock_and_io: SQLITE_BUSY, SQLITE_LOCKED, I/O, FULL, CORRUPT, NOTADB, CANTOPEN, schema drift, setting drift, fsync/durability uncertainty, and unexpected exceptions normalize to AUTHORIZATION_USE_UNRESOLVED; no protected operation enters.
sqlite_contract.ambiguous_commit: After COMMIT is issued and an error/connection loss occurs, perform at most one new-connection read-only recheck. Exact use plus exact coupled ledger row returns CONSUMED; missing, partial, mismatching, or unreadable state returns UNRESOLVED. Never repeat INSERT.
sqlite_contract.permanence: No API, DDL, cleanup, expiry, correction, revocation, or administrative action deletes, resets, or reuses a consumed use key.
sqlite_contract.distributed_claim: No distributed, replicated, network-filesystem, multi-site, or cross-database single-use claim is made.
sqlite_contract.synthetic_cleanup: Create with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory on a qualified local filesystem; close all connections; verify realpath containment; remove only database, -journal, -wal, and -shm if present; then remove that directory. Production cleanup is forbidden.
